title: Spotify labels AI artists after Bureau investigation
key_facts: Spotify is now labelling synthetic artists with an "AI Persona" badge, announced 11 Aug 2026 and rolling out over recent weeks.
The Bureau's reporting was on Danny Bones, an AI rapper with over 1 million streams, made by the Node Project (Denver Bamber and Theo Blackledge).
Spotify announced the badge six days after the Bureau asked about disclosure of synthetic artists; Spotify said listeners had complained about profiles they believed were real people.
Music from AI personas is excluded from editorial and personalised recommendations unless listeners already follow the artist.
The badge says nothing about whether the music itself is AI-generated; a separate AI credits system is still in beta.
The Bureau previously found the Node Project made campaign material for the far-right party Advance UK, paid £4,000.
quote_evidence: Spotify is now labelling synthetic artists after our reporting into the far-right, AI rapper Danny Bones, who has racked up over 1 million streams.
Music from AI personas is also excluded from editorial and personalised recommendations unless listeners have already followed or engaged with an artist on Spotify.
The badge says nothing about whether the music itself is AI-generated.
why_it_matters_hint: A big streaming service now flags AI-invented artists, but not AI-made music.
event_date: Badge announced 11 Aug 2026; rollout reported 15 Oct 2026
notes: The Bureau is both reporter and a party that claims influence on Spotify; Spotify confirmed the badge for Danny Bones to the Bureau. Pool score 6 lowered to 5: policy announced two months ago.
